I am a researcher in Econometrics, Machine Learning, and Mechanism Design, now joining the PhD program in Economics at UC San Diego. I focus on theory for applied research, including but not limited to the problems businesses face. For now, you can check out our paper *Treatment Allocation under Uncertain Costs*.

My research agenda took shape during my work at [Yandex.Go](https://go.yandex/), the Department of Economics at Moscow State University, and the [Research Fellowship program at Stanford](https://www.gsb.stanford.edu/programs/research-fellows). I am grateful to my former (and current) colleagues for their contributions to my skills, my knowledge, and my sense of what constitutes important research.
